stories.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
stories.summary: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.

stories.title: After more than two decades, U.S. forces prepare to leave Iraq
stories.summary: The U.S. military formally ends a more than two-decade-long presence in Iraq this week.

stories.title: CNN is getting new owners with close ties to Trump
stories.summary: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.

stories.title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
stories.summary: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

stories.title: We're looking for life on other planets. Are we ready to find it?
stories.summary: In 1960, astronomer Frank Drake listened for signals from alien worlds. Reporter Brendan Byrne's podcast When We Find Them picks up the search and asks what would happen if we finally find something.

stories.title: At the Smithsonian, Maya Angelou's typewriter holds a place of honor
stories.summary: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.
